scene.speaker: freya
scene.bubble: The magic word game! Two teams, many words, one golden star… and Pip as the judge!
scene.intro: The magic word game! Two teams, a pile of word cards and one golden star for the winner. Freya's team points at the pictures and guesses fast; Nico's team guesses even faster, but they shout the words in the wrong order. Point, guess, clap! Pip is the referee, and Pip is not very fair. Do you remember all the words of the course? Choose a team and play!

data.voice_note: Voces: Freya (presentadora) y Nico (capitán de equipo).
data.script: Freya: Magic word game, final round! Team Sun against Team Star. … Nico: Team Sun is ready! … Freya: First word: it is big, grey, with a long nose. … Nico: ELEPHANT! One point! … Freya: It is cold, white, and you eat it in summer. … Nico: ICE CREAM! … Freya: Last word: he is black and white and he is our friend. … Nico: PIP! … Freya: Team Sun wins with eight points! And the golden star goes to… everyone!

outcomes.puede: Follow classroom instructions; identify familiar words in songs and short spoken sentences.
Greet; say name, age, colours; name objects; answer yes/no questions.
Recognise all 26 letters; match words to pictures (family, food, animals, body).
